limitations: Test participates in checkpoint selection; final results are not independent blind-test estimates.
One seed only; sub-percent differences do not establish reproducible superiority.

Dataset characteristics describe aggregate plausibility; no per-size/per-class error attribution or trained-checkpoint module ablation was performed in this analysis.
